[[File:FC Obolon Kyiv.png|thumb|Old logo]]
'''FC Obolon Kyiv''' ({{langx|uk|Оболонь Київ}}, {{IPA|uk|oboˈǀɔnʲ ˈkɪjiu̯|pron}}) is a [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Kyiv]] ([[Obolonskyi District]]). Its home colors are green shirts and white shorts; while its away uniforms are white shirts and green shorts. Its main sponsor was the brewery [[Obolon CJSC|Obolon]] in 1999–2013. Since 2013, the club is owned by the factory.

The club was reformed in 2013 due to administrative issues and hence the team withdrew from the [[Professional Football League of Ukraine]] during the [[2012–13 Ukrainian First League]] season in February 2013.<ref name="finance">{{Cite web|url=http://news.liga.net/news/sport/764405-slobodyan_otkazalsya_finansirovat_fk_obolon.htm|trans-title=Slobodyan refused to fund FC Obolon|publisher=www.liga.net|date=9 December 2012|script-title=ru:Слободян отказался финансировать ФК "Оболонь"|language=ru|access-date=21 April 2013|archive-date=13 March 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130313110548/http://news.liga.net/news/sport/764405-slobodyan_otkazalsya_finansirovat_fk_obolon.htm|url-status=live}}</ref> The club restarted from amateur competitions. Between 2013 and 2020, the team was known as '''Obolon-Brovar Kyiv'''.<ref name="1088222388Obolon-Brovar">{{in lang|uk}} [https://ua.tribuna.com/football/1088222388/ Obolon-Brovar was renamed to Obolon. Changed the emblem of the club] ,  (21 August 2020)</ref>"}}
